upcomingEmpty: No interviews, tests or deadlines in the next 7 days.

panels.bestFitEmpty: No jobs to review. New ones arrive through alerts, the companies you follow or “New job”.
panels.readyEmpty: No CV ready. Approve jobs and ask your agent for the CV.

firstSteps.title: Getting started
firstSteps.intro: Two steps and your agent starts searching for you. No need to fill anything in by hand.

profile.title: Create your profile from your CV
profile.body: Upload your CV (PDF or Word) and your agent fills in your profile: it asks about what the CV doesn't say and saves nothing without your OK.
profile.done: Profile created: review it in “My profile”

search.title: Choose where to search
search.body: Your agent asks which job boards you use, recommends others and prepares the searches with the roles in your profile.
search.manual: or add a job board yourself
search.done: Job boards set up: see them in “Where to search”
